title: What is better to enhance the solubility of hydrophobic compounds in aqueous solutions: eutectic solvents or ionic liquids?
content:
RSC Sustain., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00379A, Paper

Olga Ferreira, Liliana P. Silva, Heloísa H. S. Almeida, Jordana Benfica, Dinis O. Abranches, Simão P. Pinho, João A. P. Coutinho
The solubilities of three solutes in aqueous solutions of ionic liquids (choline glycolate and choline malonate) and the analogous eutectic solvents (choline chloride:glycolic acid and choline chloride:malonic acid) were studied.
